question: Should OpenClaw reject every user-managed stable Codex app-server newer than the bundled validated `0.144.5`, or keep the prior open-ended stable-version acceptance until each newer protocol is validated?
rationale: Both choices are plausible compatibility policies: a ceiling prevents unvalidated generated-protocol drift, but it can break existing custom `appServer.command` deployments during ordinary Codex upgrades.

options.title: Keep the validated ceiling
options.body: Reject versions above `0.144.5` and treat generated-schema validation as the required contract before each supported Codex upgrade.

options.title: Warn but allow newer stable versions
options.body: Preserve current custom-server upgrade behavior while warning that versions newer than the bundled contract are unvalidated.

recommendation.title: Keep the validated ceiling
recommendation.body: Reject versions above `0.144.5` and treat generated-schema validation as the required contract before each supported Codex upgrade.
